calls.title: Dashboard Discussion
calls.summary: The meeting addressed current challenges in sales activity tracking, highlighting a preference for Apollo data over HubSpot for its accuracy in capturing account activity. Participants discussed the significant shortfall in call volume by Jake, who made 359 calls against a target of 1,035, leading to a review of data syncing issues. A spreadsheet-based reporting tool was introduced for tracking sales and AE activities, with plans for automation in the future. Compensation for Jake is tied to four KPIs, with ongoing clarity needed on metrics related to meetings held and no-show tracking. Additionally, recent client renewals were secured, providing stable revenue, while discussions on BI tools and operational improvements were identified for future growth.
calls.keywords: Apollo, HubSpot, BI Dashboard, Call Tracking, Light Dash, ETL Automation
calls.action_items:
**Jeff Ignacio**
Investigate and automate syncing of Apollo activity data into HubSpot to reduce manual data entry and improve data reliability (03:00)
Set up and share access to the coefficient ETL tool with Brent and Ryan to enable automatic data refresh for the Google Sheets reporting dashboard (11:25)
Block Fridays to manually update and maintain the Google Sheets reporting dashboard until automation is fully implemented (29:45)
Troubleshoot the absence of Jake’s recent call activity in Apollo and validate data completeness to identify any reporting gaps or issues (26:50)
Explore automation options for dashboard updates and assess associated licensing or operational costs to improve reporting efficiency (30:00)

**Brent Holloway**
Confirm with Ryan to add a tracking section for Matt in the progress dashboard to reflect his activities and KPIs (12:05)
Share the "road to club" Google Sheets dashboard and process details with Ryan during the noon meeting for alignment and feedback (12:10)
Follow up with Jake regarding actual calling activities and any discrepancies in call reporting to ensure accurate performance tracking (27:00)
Consider exploration of Light Dash BI tool as a potential alternative or complement to existing BI solutions and provide feedback or integration ideas (01:40)
Coordinate with Jeff on coefficient ETL tool setup and access sharing for Ryan and Brent to enable streamlined data management (11:40)

**Ryan**
Approve any budget required for full automation of dashboard data refreshes to support efficient and timely reporting (11:45)
Confirm compensation plan details for Jake to finalize KPI targets and variable pay inputs in the dashboard for accurate performance measurement (12:40)
